analyst.summary: Sona Comstar is one of the better-positioned Indian auto-component makers for the shift to electric vehicles, with a genuine and growing EV traction-motor business, and it just posted accelerating revenue growth (54% year-on-year) plus a new entry into robotics. The business is executing well, but the stock has already re-rated substantially and prices in a good deal of that success. We rate it a Hold: a quality EV-transition winner, priced for continued strong execution rather than offering a discount.
